title: Sobol sensitivity analysis of an M/M/1 queue in simmer
text: consider simple M/M/1 queue simulated simmer package. Two input parameters uncertain lambda arrival rate (interarrival times distributed Exp(lambda)) mu service rate (service times distributed Exp(mu)) study impact two parameters mean waiting time queue stationarity using Sobol indices.

title: Sobol sensitivity analysis of an M/M/1 queue in simmer
text: reduce Monte Carlo noise, define quantity interest (QoI) equal mean waiting time several independent replications parameter pair (lambda, mu).
code: # M/M/1 simmer model for Sobol analysis using time in system as QoI  library(simmer) # One replication: mean time in system (sojourn time) simulate_mm1_once_ts <- function(lambda, mu,                                  horizon = 1000,                                  warmup  = 200) {   traj <- trajectory("customer") %>%     seize("server") %>%     timeout(function() rexp(1, rate = mu)) %>%     release("server")      env <- simmer("MM1_queue") %>%     add_resource("server", capacity = 1, queue_size = Inf) %>%     add_generator(       name_prefix  = "cust",       trajectory   = traj,       distribution = function() rexp(1, rate = lambda)     )      env <- run(env, until = horizon)   arr <- get_mon_arrivals(env)      # Keep only post warmup   arr <- arr[arr$end_time > warmup, , drop = FALSE]      if (nrow(arr) == 0L) {     return(0)   }      # Time in system = end_time - start_time   ts <- arr$end_time - arr$start_time      m <- mean(ts, na.rm = TRUE)   if (!is.finite(m)) m <- 0   m }  # Quick sanity check simulate_mm1_once_ts(lambda = 1/5, mu = 1/4) #> [1] 11.99866 # QoI: average mean time in system over replications simulate_mm1_qoi_ts <- function(lambda, mu,                                 horizon = 1000,                                 warmup  = 200,                                 nrep   = 20L) {   nrep <- as.integer(nrep)   if (nrep < 1L) stop("'nrep' must be at least 1")   vals <- replicate(     nrep,     simulate_mm1_once_ts(lambda = lambda, mu = mu,                          horizon = horizon, warmup = warmup)   )   mean(vals) }  simulate_mm1_qoi_ts(lambda = 1/5, mu = 1/4) #> [1] 20.65865
